# v0.2.0 (Unstable)
First release. I've completed a few runs with this now, so I think it's ready to be called unstable.
## Known Issues in this release
Minor cosmetic issues with items in the world sometimes
A couple edge logic issues
A softlock in the elevator I cannot reproduce for the life of me. If the LiftBot's head disappears and you're no longer able to leave the elevator, I'd love to get a save file from you

## General Tips
Ctrl+C opens the cheat menu, which allows teleporting around the ship. This shouldn't cause any major issues, but I would be careful spawning items, because that may get messy.

Find installation instructions at [https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation)

v0.2.1.description:
# v0.2.1 (Unstable)
Bug fix release. Both Client and .apworld updated
## Changes
- Added a missing logic rule for the Auditory Center
- Granted items with an in-world pickup location should now get put into the right spot in the viewport
- Fixed a logic issue with the Vision Center puzzle
- Fixed rendering issue with Speech Center
- Fixed an issue where the Lemon location check would be impossible if you already used the AP-granted lemon in the Bar puzzle
## Known Issues in this release
- Cosmetic issues with items in the world sometimes
- A softlock in the elevator I cannot reproduce for the life of me. If the LiftBot's head disappears and you're no longer able to leave the elevator, I'd love to get a save file from you. You can teleport out of the elevator with the Ctrl-C menu, which fixes the issue

## General Tips
- Ctrl+C opens the cheat menu, which allows teleporting around the ship. This shouldn't cause any major issues, but I would be careful spawning items, because that may get messy.
- No visual tracker yet, but for now I highly recommend Universal Tracker to see in-logic checks

Find installation instructions at [https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation)
